_meta.what: Turning-day data skeleton for the market year's 24 canonical cards. One record per turning day. Computed fields come from data/produce.json (in-season at slot midpoint, fine-parse of season strings, mediterranean band = superset; med_only items read 'out' in temperate markets). Hand fields are editorial and carry verification flags.
rules: Governing doc: Turning_Day_Card_Template_Law.md (same folder). Law wins over this file; this file wins over guesses.
plate_candidates = the MENU at slot midpoint, not the pick. Final 9 (or fewer) chosen at production, ledger-checked.

Plate-fidelity ledger applies: berries plate reads as strawberries (never label blackberry); greengage reads as apple (namesake, always labelled); shared plates: plum=damson, courgette=marrow, tomato x4, pods x8, bell-pepper+chilli, stone-fruit x3, parsley (never label basil).
label_language decided at production per the Law: located dispatch -> vantage language + NAMED FROM line; above-the-map -> per-plate most-decoder-worthy language, tagged.
saints_strip: every form must be verified before shipping (field-guide standard). Entries here are candidates, not facts.
lore: verbatim from a named checkable collection or nothing. lore_leads are TOPICS to research, never copy to print as-is.

WINTER CAVEAT: presence stays ~32 items through winter (storage roots, brassicas, citrus). The January 'vast field' concept keys off ARRIVALS (mid-Jan: purple-sprouting broccoli alone), not presence. Use peak flags + arrivals, not raw candidate count, when judging a card's density.
slug_candidate is provisional until the per-day polyglot slug pass + app-route collision check.
vantage: null until the dispatch is written. The card is downstream of the dispatch.

COMPUTED FIELDS LIVE IN THE BUILD, NOT HERE. This file holds editorial fields only: num, numeral, name, slug_candidate, great_turn, opens, closes, days, working_name, lore_leads, strip_note. Anything derived from produce.json is computed by scripts/build-market-year.mjs.

computed_fields_removed.why: Derived from data/produce.json by a finer parser than the app ships, on 2026-07-30, then frozen. They gave the 24 turns only 8 distinct stall lists and could not track the season_ranges work. Recomputed at build time by scripts/build-market-year.mjs via seasonalityOf(). See SEASON-SEAM.md.
